uploads/2/4/3/7/24378647/grey-square1_3..text: It’s very natural to desire safety and intimacy within our marriage and close relationships but oftentimes we deny who we are in order to be accepted, in essence we betray ourselves. Or there are times we might hide behind masks and barriers and this cuts off our ability to engage in a deeper connection and closeness. The people we are the most intimate with are those who push our “buttons” the most. Sometimes those people can be our greatest teachers if we learn to understand why we are reacting to them the way we do.
